g.text: AFTER MVP — Proposed separate deployment approval and target-effect reconciliation
approve exact artifact / target / configuration / recovery plan
validate current authority + usable artifact + provenance
guard approval inputs + target generation; commit intent
scoped dispatch with stable attempt identity
applied version + health / data effect evidence
record actual confirmed / failed / partial result
preserve unknown effect; block incompatible repeat
reconcile same attempt and actual target state
actual outcome; recovery is separately evaluated
Local commit does not prove remote success or rollback.
No blind resend after an unknown effect.
Older code cannot automatically undo irreversible data changes.
